metadata.design: Single English nouns, each given alone as the user message with a space first (" eagle"), so that each is one token, the same token the word has inside sentences. The label is the semantic category (8). Each category has 5 families (subcategories), held out whole in validation. Animacy and concreteness follow from the category (animate: animal and person; abstract: emotion and idea), so they nest above it. Valence crosses the categories where the words allow.
metadata.author: Claude Code, in one pass, one author for every category
